patches.value: muH(a) denotes the native unnormalized Borel Hausdorff measure MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a. It is obtained by the metric outer-measure construction mkMetric with gauge r↦r^a on extended nonnegative diameters: at each positive scale take the maximal outer measure bounded by the gauge on all nonempty sets of at most that diameter, then take the supremum over scales and its Borel-measure realization. Values on arbitrary sets mean outer-measure values. Empty covering members cost zero and nonempty members cost diam^a with extended nonnegative-real powers; at a=0 a nonempty singleton has cost 1.

dimH(A), also written dim_H A, is the standard Hausdorff dimension: sup({a≥0 : muH(a)(A)=infinity}) in [0,infinity], where the supremum of an empty set is 0. This is the native dimH definition. The notation uses the empty-set dimension convention 0. Critical-exponent properties and agreement with the supplied positive-exponent diameter-cost measure are proof obligations, not extra assumptions.
D=dimH(E), initially an extended nonnegative real. Real arithmetic involving D is used only after its finiteness is proved.
